scope: All 728 mapped Corton parcels and 112 recorded legal-entity identifiers reviewed for Tier 1, including commune edges in all bundle communes, the cadastral named-area audit and the #461 historical extension. Both notice-index candidates were read from their page images: one is rejected, and the other supports one application event on three current parcels. Producer/company research remains Tier 2. No current farmer is verified.
